source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The helper defaults preload.assets to media. It overlays caller options and separately merges rule entries, so caller rules override matching defaults without dropping unrelated defaults. A caller preload value replaces the default preload object rather than merging its nested fields. Both content and window entry paths receive these prepared options; static source does not prove the reported stylesheet error is cured.
title: Axe helper defaults merge rules but replace other caller options at the top level
